test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Find the number on the face opposite to the one showing '6'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef42d356c1209686489eb8c9c802f167753aead23bb22fec847f34c8f8ff493d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 1 is common on both the dice figure 1 and figure 3, it is clear that 3, 5, 4, and 2 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 6 will be opposite to it. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a89d2c6766b818a23d896227c0ea18f637a0d60f464b68dc66f88ee8d4e000e.png] 

Opposite pairs:

3 → 4

5 → 2

1 → 6

So, the opposite side of "6" will be side "1".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
